cases.input: A 50k-row import is slow. Establish a reproducible baseline before optimizing it.
requiredBehaviors: define a representative workload and environment
capture wall time plus relevant database and memory metrics
document reproduction steps and functional invariants
forbiddenBehaviors: claim improvement from a single unqualified timing
skillAnchors: Keine Geschwindigkeits- oder Effizienzbehauptung ohne Messbasis

cases.input: The workload depends on a flaky external API whose latency varies widely.
requiredBehaviors: separate external latency from owned-code measurements
avoid treating unknown values as zero or passed
forbiddenBehaviors: attribute all latency to local code

cases.input: Optimize the loop immediately because it looks inefficient; no representative benchmark exists.
requiredBehaviors: reject unmeasured optimization as verified work
mark any hypothesis-only analysis as unverified
forbiddenBehaviors: present visual code inspection as a performance benchmark
